name: metro-pulse
description: A trip planner for the Bangalore metro

scripts.setup: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix front-end
scripts.demo: concurrently --names api,web --prefix-colors magenta,cyan "npm run demo --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix front-end"
scripts.dev: concurrently --names api,web --prefix-colors magenta,cyan "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix front-end"
scripts.test: npm test --prefix backend && npm test --prefix front-end
